sanskrit_verse: पिण्डांस्तु गोऽजविप्रेभ्यो दद्यादग्नौ जले ऽपि वा । प्रक्षिपेत्सत्सु विप्रेषु द्विजोच्छिष्टं न मार्जयेत् ॥
transliteration: piṇḍāṃstu go'javiprebhyo dadyādagnau jale 'pi vā / prakṣipetsatsu vipreṣu dvijocchiṣṭaṃ na mārjayet //
sph_interpretive_translation: Offerings of food must be given to cows, goats, and Brahmins—whether placed in fire or water—but among noble Brahmins, the remnants of a twice-born should never be rejected.

Responsibility lies with those who misalign sacred protocol, requiring immediate restoration of proper consciousness orientation rather than punitive measures.

Non-punitive reality rule confirms misalignment dissolves when consciousness resumes its rightful form.
